FROM customer_amounts
ORDER BY "客户编号" ASC

query.sql:
WITH target_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = '已完成'
    AND strftime('%Y', o.day) = '2025'
    AND l.sku = 'P-A'
),
customer_amounts AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id AS "客户编号",
         ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.qty AS REAL) * l.price_cents * (1.0 - CAST(l.discount_bp AS REAL) / 10000.0)), 2) AS "P-A明细折后金额(分)"
  FROM orders o
  JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = '已完成'
    AND strftime('%Y', o.day) = '2025'
    AND l.sku = 'P-A'
    AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customers)
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT "客户编号",
         "P-A明细折后金额(分)",
         CASE WHEN SUM("P-A明细折后金额(分)") OVER () = 0 THEN NULL
              ELSE ROUND("P-A明细折后金额(分)" * 100.0 / SUM("P-A明细折后金额(分)") OVER (), 2)
         END AS "占比(%)"
  FROM customer_amounts
)
SELECT "客户编号", "P-A明细折后金额(分)", "占比(%)"
FROM with_ratio
ORDER BY "占比(%)" DESC, "客户编号" ASC
LIMIT 3
